normalization: No split synonym entries; packet positions equal normalized positions.
surfactantArchitecture: Sodium Laureth Sulfate (2, defining, ether type); Cocamidopropyl Betaine (3) and Coco-Glucoside (4) buffers; no reinforcing anionic.

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic is ether/sulfonate type with at least one prominent buffer and no prominent reinforcing strong anionic -> moderate. SLES (2) buffered by CAPB (3) and Coco-Glucoside (4).
cleansingStrength.counterSignal: Glyceryl Oleate (6) refatting; few conditioning routes so no strong counter-signal.

conditioningLevel.rationale: One meaningful conditioning system: Hydroxypropyl Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride (8) plus light routes Glyceryl Oleate (6), Panthenol (11), Glycerin (15), Ascorbyl Palmitate (14). C2 not met (no silicone, payload lipid or pearlizer) -> moderate.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Only one cationic polymer and weak refatters; low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: Low: one cationic guar plus weak refatters against an effective SLES/betaine/glucoside reset.

depositionLoad.rationale: Single cationic guar (8); Glyceryl Oleate (6) and Ascorbyl Palmitate (14) are weak refatters.

persistence.rationale: No silicone, payload lipid or film former; guar alone is weakly retained.

resetCapacity.rationale: C1 moderate SLES chassis with two buffers.

weightPotential.counterSignal: Guar is listed early (8) and could deposit noticeably with SLES coacervation.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only deposition is one cationic guar plus weak refatters; reset is effective.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate (W2): the two families are a single cationic guar and weak refatters only; no silicone, lipid or film former to form a coacervate payload, and an effective SLES/betaine/glucoside reset faces only light routes.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Guar level/charge density unknown; could move to moderate.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Recognized dandruff active present; scalp_active is compatible if dandruff positioning appears.

careDirection.basis: Panthenol and Glycerin are late and single; one guar; distinguishes neither repair nor moisture.

focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Empty default; a secondary needs distinct positioning (Section 8), not visible yet.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). Default regular (Section 9); triggers need graded claims. treatment possible if a qualifying dandruff claim appears (U3).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (blind): claims, name and usage directions hidden (3.1); final value set after unblinding (3.2). SC1 positioning not visible. CSA formula half: passes: prominent comfort Panthenol (11); prominent humectants Glycerin (15), Glyceryl Oleate (6).

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains Piroctone Olamine (position 13), a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11). Formula-only; whether a dandruff target projects depends on a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
dandruffSupport.counterSignal: None for the formula fact; positioning not yet visible.
